ev.q: conducted a rapid needs assessment to gauge the prevalence of injuries and health complaints
Only 3.9% of households indicated a current need for assistance in obtaining emergency shelter
the greatest need among surveyed households was for assistance obtaining food (26.8%)
Households with older adults represented the largest portion (36.1%) of households with vulnerable members.
To conduct the assessment, the health department used a cluster sampling technique

methods_quotes.q: from which a simple random sample of 75 clusters was selected for assessment.
responses were weighted for probability of household selection within clusters to adjust for variations in sampling
Weighted proportions and 95% confidence intervals were calculated using statistical software.
